name: Quanta Services
outlook:
What Quanta Services says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenues and net incomeFor the full year ending December 31, 2026, Quanta now expects revenues to range between $41.3 billion and $41.6 billion and net income attributable to common stock to range between $1.92 billion and $1.98 billion.
  • Full year 2026: earnings per shareQuanta also now expects diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock to range between $12.57 and $12.97 and adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock to range between $17.90 and $18.30.
  • Full year 2026: EBITDAQuanta now expects EBITDA to range between $3.99 billion and $4.09 billion and adjusted EBITDA to range between $4.40 billion and $4.49 billion.
  • Full year 2026: cash flowAdditionally, for the full year ending December 31, 2026, Quanta now expects net cash provided by operating activities to range between $3.45 billion and $4.00 billion and free cash flow (a non-GAAP financial measure) to range between $2.50 billion and $3.00 billion.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
